text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock Satin Chrome Top Guard with Rim Cylinder, MTL-TOPDEC-626

Mul-T-Lock's Top-Guard is a reinforced hardened steel face, concealed by a decorative coverplate protecting a Mul-T-Lock Rim Cylinder. Designed to hold up to the most determined physical attacks, takes cylinder security to the next level. Thick steel and thru-bolt mounting resists wrenching, prying, drilling and hammer attacks. Hardened steel plug protector resists cylinder drilling attacks.

High security surface mounted exterior plate combined with a MUL-T-LOCK exterior high security lock cylinder. Supplied with two (2) keys, owner key card and matching finish mounting screws in Satin Chrome finish.

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock's Top Guard with Rim Cylinder

  • UL437 Drill and Pick Resistance
  • Bump Proof Lock Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206S Security Keyway
  • 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

MUL-T-LOCK's locks are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.
